description: Find HEARTH hunts relevant to a threat actor (name, alias or ATT&CK group id such as APT29, Cozy Bear or G0016). A hunt matches when it shares ATT&CK techniques with the actor or names the actor in its text; hunts naming the actor come first, then hunts sharing the most distinctive techniques (see relevance). Also returns how much of the actor's known technique profile HEARTH covers and the biggest uncovered techniques.

actor.description: Actor name, alias or ATT&CK group id

data_sources.description: Only hunts runnable with ANY of these data source categories

name: hunts_for_actor

gap_techniques.description: Actor technique ids, sub-techniques included, with no hunt; total_gaps is the parent-level count

full_matches.description: With data_sources: hunts whose every data source you have

gaps.description: Uncovered actor techniques, most used by ATT&CK groups first (first 25). Same rule as coverage_gaps: parent techniques, a hunt on any sub-technique covers its parent, Reconnaissance and Resource Development left out.

group_count.description: ATT&CK groups known to use it (for a parent technique, or any of its sub-techniques)

submit_url.description: Where to submit a hunt for it

origin.description: declared: the hunt's own labels; attack: derived from its ATT&CK techniques

missing_sources.description: With data_sources: categories this hunt uses that you don't have

relevance.description: Sum over shared techniques of how rare each is among ATT&CK groups. Under 1.5 means only commonly used techniques are shared: a weak match.

other_matches.description: Other actors the name could refer to; call again with one of these ids

submit_hunt.description: Present when HEARTH has no hunt for part of the request: where to submit one

total_gaps.description: Actor techniques no HEARTH hunt covers, counted as coverage_gaps counts them

title: HEARTH hunts for a threat actor
